scientific_question: Can one overlap-safe Frozen-KV MTP scheduling intervention remove enough assistant/verify serialization and low-acceptance tail cost to make the exact stacked c32 endpoint cross 0.6381105231 seconds per request?

source_runtime_signal.message: Overlap scheduler is disabled when using Frozen-KV MTP speculative decoding (spec v2 is not supported yet).
source_runtime_signal.tail_observation: The exact server log falls from 32 running requests with accept rate 0.70-0.86 to four running requests with accept rate 0.04-0.13.

immutable.workload: 32 requests at c32, 4214 prompt and 358 completion tokens, 117728 fresh plus 17120 cached prompt tokens
immutable.target_consumer: dynamic FP8 plus fused QKV on target layers
immutable.assistant_consumer: stock QKV on KV-shared assistant layers

required_before_gpu: exact pinned source path for the overlap-disable decision and assistant/verify serialization
one concrete intervention with a causal event or counter prediction
oracle or analytical bound showing a plausible endpoint at or below 0.6381105231 seconds per request

endpoint_gate.required_path_proof: target, assistant, QKV, accepted-depth, and new overlap/serialization intervention

forbidden: proposal-depth, draft-token, top-k, cache, concurrency, or workload sweep
repair or normalization of the consumed cache-mismatched candidate
provider creation or lifecycle mutation by the researcher
